verdict.rationale: Orama is a search/vector database platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. First-party docs state that every Orama Cloud project ships an auto-configured MCP server [orama-docs-20], reachable by copying a server URL into MCP-capable assistants such as ChatGPT and Cursor [orama-docs-46, orama-docs-9]. The page is linked from llms.txt and probed live [orama-probe-1, orama-probe-3]. Missing for 10: details on the exposed MCP tools and auth/permissions, MCP server for the open-source Orama JS library (Cloud-only per evidence), independent or hands-on corroboration.
